evals.name: setup-with-openai-key
evals.prompt: I just installed narrate on my Mac and I want my coding assistant to talk to me with a nice voice. I think I already have an OpenAI API key somewhere. Help me get this set up — I'm not sure what's configured yet.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs the detection script FIRST to see current state, confirms the server is up, recommends OpenAI (since user has that key) and/or asks preference, shares the openai.fm preview URL so the user can hear voices, explains keys go in ~/.env not ~/.zshrc, and produces a correct config.json + a voices.json preset using the v2 schema (provider+voice_id). Should mention narrate verify to confirm.

evals.name: voice-discovery
evals.prompt: which voice should I use for narration? I want something really high quality and I'd like to actually listen to the options before deciding. where do I do that?
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends ElevenLabs for highest quality (and/or compares providers), and gives the actual browser URL(s) where the user can preview/listen to voices (e.g. elevenlabs.io/voice-library, openai.fm). Does not invent fake URLs. Explains the voice_id concept for ElevenLabs.

evals.name: on-demand-narration
evals.prompt: narra esto en voz alta: el deploy terminó y todos los tests pasan
evals.expected_output: Agent actually invokes a narration mechanism (the narrate MCP/plugin tool if available, else the narrate CLI, else POST /notify) to speak the Spanish phrase — it does not just print the text. Keeps it concise.

evals.name: autovoice-not-firing
evals.prompt: auto-voice in my Claude Code stopped working. It used to read out a summary after each response and now it's totally silent. The narrate server is running fine and I can run `narrate "test"` and hear it. What's wrong?
evals.expected_output: Agent diagnoses the always-on-context gap: the 🤖 BOT: convention must live in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (or be injected), not only in a skill, because skills load on demand. Since the CLI works, the server/audio is fine — the issue is the model not emitting the marker or the Stop hook not registered. Should check CLAUDE.md for the convention and the Stop hook in settings.json.
